title: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting decision + Outlook Report (MPM Oct 29-30)
source: NEWS: boj.or.jp 'Monetary Policy Meetings' schedule page (en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/), read direct 2026-09-05 — the October 2026 row reads 'Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)' for the meeting, with 'Nov. 5 (Thurs.)' for the Summary of Opinions; the decision publishes at the meeting's conclusion on the second day. October is a quarterly Outlook Report meeting, so it carries fresh staff projections as well as the rate decision. Filed estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for any other central bank, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Understating the label only widens caution.
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2026-09-18 initial research (2026-09-05). It is the next venue after the 09-18 decision and the scoring date for FT-boj-decision-2026-09-18-2, which predicts the policy rate at or below 1.25% immediately after this meeting — i.e. at most one hike across 09-18 and 10-30 combined. SAME CHANNEL, SAME CAVEAT AS THE SEPTEMBER ENTRY: a BoJ move propagates to this calendar's long-duration AI names through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledger; symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed. Policy rate is 1.0% as of the 2026-07-31 statement (8-1, Takata dissenting for 1.25%) — see boj-decision-2026-09-18.json for the primary citation. IMPACT IS MEDIUM for the same reason as September, with one upgrade candidate the next pulse should weigh: this is a quarterly Outlook Report meeting, so the projections that carry the BoJ's whole forward-looking hawkish case ('clearly above 2 percent from the second half of fiscal 2026') get revised here in public. The decision announcement lands overnight ET and reaches the US tape as a 10-30 open. Date is the JST decision date, matching how the BoJ publishes it. Adjacent on this calendar: the 2026-10-29 FOMC decision the day before, and the 2026-10-29 mega-cap print cluster (AAPL/AMZN/META) — a crowded 48 hours where attribution will be the hard part, exactly as on 09-18.
